title: A 12-Bit 20-Msample/s Pipelined Analog-to-Digital Converter With Nested Digital Background Calibration
figure_number: Fig. 4. Block diagram of pipelined ADC with calibration.
function_summary: 12-Bit 20-Msample/s Pipelined Analog-to-Digital Converter: A 12-bit 20-Msample/s pipelined analog-to-digital converter (ADC) is calibrated in the background using an algorithmic ADC, which is itself calibrated in the foreground.
